dishes.name: Zesty Lemon and Seed Porridge
dishes.title: Lemon and sunflower seed porridge
dishes.method: Simmer the oats and milk in a small pan until creamy. Stir in the lemon zest and top with sunflower seeds.
dishes.why: A warm, medium-sized breakfast that incorporates the lemon flavours requested by the house while remaining stovetop-friendly.

dishes.name: Golden Seed Butter Toast
dishes.title: Sunflower seed butter on toasted bread
dishes.method: Toast the bread and spread evenly with the sunflower seed butter.
dishes.why: I have substituted one of the foods on this household's medical list for sunflower seed butter to ensure safety for everyone.

dishes.name: Zesty Nut-Free Porridge
dishes.title: Lemon and sunflower seed porridge
dishes.method: Simmer oats and milk until thickened, then stir in lemon zest and seeds.
dishes.why: A safe, nut-free version of the table's breakfast to accommodate medical constraints.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared Chicken and Rice
dishes.title: Chicken thighs with lemon green beans and rice
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, rice, and beans in a pan with a splash of water. Finish with a squeeze of lemon.
dishes.why: A large, muscle-building lunch using the stovetop to avoid the broken oven.

dishes.name: Chicken and Rice Bowl
dishes.title: Chicken thighs with lemon green beans and rice
dishes.method: Warm the components in a pan and serve as directed.
dishes.why: A protein-rich meal prepared without one of the foods on this household's medical list.

dishes.name: Safe Chicken and Bean Bowl
dishes.title: Chicken thighs with lemon green beans and rice
dishes.method: Reheat the chicken, rice, and beans in a pan until piping hot.
dishes.why: A large lunch portion that strictly avoids fennel and nuts.

dishes.name: Ginger Beef and Pepper Stir-fry
dishes.title: Beef strips with bell peppers, spinach and rice
dishes.method: Reheat the beef stir-fry and the rice in a pan. Toss until the spinach is just wilted.
dishes.why: A medium dinner focused on iron-rich beef and loud vegetables, cooked entirely on the hob.

dishes.name: Beef and Spinach Stir-fry
dishes.title: Beef strips with bell peppers, spinach and rice
dishes.method: Warm the beef and rice together in a frying pan until hot.
dishes.why: A warm dinner that avoids celeriac and provides high-quality protein.

dishes.name: Nut-Free Beef Stir-fry
dishes.title: Beef strips with bell peppers, spinach and rice
dishes.method: Heat the beef and rice in a pan. Ensure no cross-contamination with nuts.
dishes.why: A safe, medium dinner portion that avoids all tree nuts and fennel.

preparations.title: Steamed Basmati Rice (Lunch)
preparations.method: Rinse rice and boil in salted water for 10-12 minutes until tender. Drain and fluff.

preparations.title: Steamed Basmati Rice (Dinner)
preparations.method: Boil rice in salted water until tender, drain and set aside for dinner.

preparations.title: Pan-Seared Chicken Thighs
preparations.method: Season chicken and sear in a hot pan with oil for 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.

preparations.title: Steamed Green Beans
preparations.method: Steam or boil green beans for 4-5 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.

preparations.title: Ginger Beef Stir-fry with Peppers
preparations.method: Stir-fry beef and sliced peppers with ginger in a hot pan for 5 minutes. Stir in spinach at the end until just wilted.

cooking_sessions.run_through: Start both batches of rice on the hob. While they simmer, sear the chicken thighs in a large pan. Once chicken is done, use the pan to stir-fry the beef, peppers, and ginger. Steam the green beans in a separate pot. Box everything once cooked.

member_portions.portion_note: Serve chicken/beef and rice first, then add the vegetables to the side.
Serve all components mixed together on the plate.
Serve vegetables first, then add the protein and starch.
